# awx_job_template_survey_spec (Resource)

Manages the survey spec of an AWX job template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_job_template_survey_spec" "demo_job_template" {
  job_template_id = awx_job_template.demo_job_template.id
  spec = jsonencode([{
    type                 = "float"
    max                  = 1024
    min                  = 5
    choices              = ""
    default              = 10
    question_description = "I do not know"
    new_question         = false
    question_name        = "What is the percentage of failure?"
    required             = true
    variable             = "pct_failure"
  }])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_template_id` (Number) Database ID for this JobTemplate.
- `spec` (String) The survey spec for this JobTemplate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <job_template_id>
import {
  to = awx_job_template_survey_spec.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <job_template_id>
terraform import awx_job_template_survey_spec.example 1
```
